units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 62b:12">B. Bath. 62ᵇ</cite>, sq., contrad. to <he>פלגא</he>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 32:7">Lev. R. s. 32</cite>, end <he>ואנן עבדין לך פ׳ בציבורא</he> and we shall arrange a collection for you in the assembly; <he>עבדון ליה פ׳</he> they made up a purse for him.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 5:4">Lev. R. s. 5</cite> <he>עביד פְּסִיקָה למתן וכ׳</he> (not <he>למיתן</he>) arranged a subscription for a charity in the college of Tiberias.
